name: shopee-cs
description: Shopee Customer Service Chatbot — polls Shopee Open API v2 seller chat for new buyer messages, classifies intent (pricing inquiry, delivery status, return request, general), and auto-replies with rule-based templates. Reduces manual response time and improves buyer satisfaction metrics.
estimated_earnings: 3000-8000 THB/month per shop (saved labor cost) or 500-2000 THB one-time setup fee per client

requires.initial_capital: 0 (no cost — uses free Shopee Open Platform developer account)

apis.name: Shopee Open Platform API v2
key_endpoints: GET  /sellerchat/get_message             — fetch messages from a conversation
POST /sellerchat/send_message            — send reply message to buyer
GET  /order/get_order_detail             — get order detail for shipping/status queries
apis.notes: access_token valid 4 hours; use refresh_token to renew without full re-auth
